evidence.reason: Left edit removes the third argument "work" from reminders.evaluate, changing the call from evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") to evaluate(minutes, 0.1). This may alter behavior if evaluate's default calendar differs from "work".

Right edit changes the call to evaluate to use calendar ?? "benchmark", so when calendar is omitted, evaluate now receives "benchmark" instead of undefined. This could affect callers that omit the calendar argument.
Caller usage shows scheduledQuote calls reminders.reminderQuote(minutes, 0.1, "work").amount, passing an explicit calendar, so its behavior is unaffected by the right edit.
Tests call evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") and reminderQuote(30, 0.1, "work") with explicit calendars, so they do not exercise the default calendar path changed by the right edit.

result.userExplanation: 两个修改可能改变省略日历参数时的默认行为，但现有测试和调用方大多显式传入了日历，因此影响范围有限，需要进一步确认 evaluate 的默认日历逻辑。
result.suggestedAction: 建议修改 src/scheduling.ts 中的 scheduledDelay，恢复传入第三个参数 "work"，以保持与之前一致的行为。
